title: Business Capability Model
description: Visual map of the Business Capabilities Catalogue (BUS-CAP), arranged as a nested card diagram: Level 1 capabilities as groups, Level 2 capabilities as items within each group. Level 3 capabilities are out of scope for this single-slide view. Derived from BUS-CAP rather than authored directly.

meta.description: A visual map of the organisation's capabilities, arranged as a nested hierarchy.
purpose: Give a single-page view of the capability landscape for workshops and roadmap discussions.
Highlight which capabilities are strategic, differentiating, or foundational at a glance.
Provide an embeddable diagram for presentations, kept in sync with BUS-CAP.
